description: Transmission Lines, Telica Region, Nicaragua, 2001 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Geological Survey (U.S.), Pete. Chirico. Transmission lines : lines of electrical pipelines for the Telica region, Nicaragua. This layer was vectorized from original hard copy 1:50,000 topographic maps produced by the Instituto Geográfico Nacional, Nicaragua. Hurricane Mitch devastated Central America during the months of October-November of 1998. Coverage: national (NI); the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: None. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
